Pizza Express is a compact yet thoughtfully designed restaurant management game that blends hands-on cooking with broader business decision-making, creating an experience that feels both energetic and personal. Developed by Onni Interactive and published by Plug In Digital, the game puts players in charge of a small pizzeria with big ambitions, challenging them to balance creativity, efficiency, and strategy within a limited timeframe. Rather than overwhelming players with complex systems from the outset, it introduces its mechanics gradually, allowing the charm of running a pizza shop to shine through while steadily increasing the pressure.

At the heart of the game is the daily rhythm of restaurant life. Each in-game day is a cycle of preparation, service, and reflection, where decisions made before opening hours directly affect how smoothly things run once customers arrive. During service, gameplay becomes fast-paced and tactile, requiring players to assemble pizzas quickly and accurately as orders stack up and patience runs thin. Mistakes cost money and reputation, while efficiency and consistency lead to satisfied customers and growing profits. This constant push and pull between speed and precision keeps the experience engaging and mirrors the stress and satisfaction of real kitchen work.

What sets Pizza Express apart from simpler cooking games is the level of control it gives players over their menu. Rather than relying on predefined recipes, the game encourages experimentation by offering a wide range of ingredients that can be combined freely. Players can name their pizzas, set prices, and adjust offerings based on customer preferences and profitability. This creative freedom adds a strong personal touch, as success often comes from understanding what your particular clientele enjoys rather than blindly following optimal strategies. Over time, the menu becomes a reflection of the player’s decisions and priorities.

Beyond the kitchen, Pizza Express incorporates light management systems that add depth without becoming cumbersome. Investments in furniture, advertising, and upgrades allow players to shape how their restaurant grows and how customers perceive it. These systems are straightforward but meaningful, rewarding thoughtful planning and adaptation. The game’s limited timeframe adds tension, forcing players to make choices about where to focus their resources instead of trying to optimize everything at once.

The presentation reinforces the game’s approachable tone. Pixel art visuals are clean and expressive, ensuring that information is easy to read even during hectic service periods. Characters and customers have distinct personalities conveyed through animation and dialogue, giving the restaurant a sense of place rather than making it feel like an abstract management screen. The soundtrack complements this atmosphere with upbeat, retro-inspired tracks that enhance the feeling of a busy but cozy pizzeria.

Replayability is supported through flexible difficulty options and multiple ways to approach the same goal. Players can fine-tune the challenge to suit their preferences, whether they want a more relaxed experience focused on creativity or a demanding run that tests their multitasking and planning skills. This adaptability makes the game accessible to newcomers while still offering enough challenge to keep experienced simulation fans engaged.

While Pizza Express does not aim for the depth of large-scale tycoon games or the narrative ambition of story-heavy sims, it succeeds by staying focused on what it does best. Its systems are cohesive, its goals are clear, and its tone remains consistent throughout. Minor rough edges in balance or pacing may appear during longer sessions, but they rarely overshadow the enjoyment of watching a small pizzeria grow through smart decisions and hard work.

Ultimately, Pizza Express delivers a satisfying blend of action and strategy that captures the spirit of running a restaurant without unnecessary complexity. It rewards creativity, quick thinking, and adaptability, all wrapped in a charming presentation that makes each successful day feel earned. For players who enjoy management games with an active, hands-on component and a strong sense of personality, Pizza Express offers a memorable and engaging experience that punches above its modest scope.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Pizza Express: Da Massa à Fama em uma Aventura Gastronômica

Introdução:
Prepare-se para uma jornada emocionante e saborosa com "Pizza Express". Este jogo de simulação de restaurante em ritmo acelerado coloca você no papel de Gastone, um trabalhador incansável, e seu amigo Lucky, conhecido pela sua imprudência. Juntos, vocês embarcarão em uma aventura culinária que os levará de iniciantes a heróis na arte da pizza. Gerencie todos os aspectos da sua pizzaria e transforme-a no melhor restaurante da cidade.

Gestão de Pizzaria:
Em "Pizza Express", você terá a oportunidade de gerenciar cada aspecto de sua pizzaria. Isso inclui preparar ingredientes frescos, cozinhar pizzas deliciosas, atender pedidos dos clientes e expandir seu negócio à medida que ganha fama e reputação.

Desafios e Aprendizado:
Ao longo do jogo, você enfrentará desafios crescentes que testarão suas habilidades de gerenciamento e sua capacidade de lidar com situações inesperadas. À medida que você supera esses obstáculos, também aprenderá receitas novas e aprimorará suas habilidades culinárias.

Desenvolvimento de Personagens:
A história envolvente do jogo se desenrola à medida que Gastone e Lucky crescem como personagens. Suas personalidades únicas e seus momentos divertidos adicionam um toque de charme à narrativa.

Visualmente Delicioso:
Os visuais de "Pizza Express" são vibrantes e repletos de detalhes, criando um ambiente aconchegante e convidativo. A atmosfera da pizzaria e os pratos de dar água na boca tornam a experiência ainda mais agradável.

Recomendação:
"Pizza Express" é uma escolha altamente recomendada para os entusiastas de jogos de simulação e para aqueles que adoram uma boa história gastronômica. Este jogo oferece uma experiência completa de gerenciamento de restaurante, desde a preparação das pizzas até o atendimento aos clientes e a expansão do negócio. É uma jornada deliciosa de zero a herói no mundo da culinária. Prepare-se para uma aventura repleta de sabor, desafios e aprendizado, enquanto você se torna um mestre da pizza e transforma sua pizzaria na melhor da cidade. "Pizza Express" é um prato cheio para aqueles que apreciam jogos cativantes e divertidos. Então, coloque seu avental e prepare-se para cozinhar, servir e conquistar o coração de seus clientes em uma deliciosa jornada.

Well, my experience within the "pizza game genre" wasn't all that great before this one. I mean, until then, I've only played a shareware version of Pizza Syndicate and didn't really understand what the heck was going on. Nonetheless, I decided to keep an open mind about it and see for myself what this was all about

So as the story goes, through an acquaintance with a crazy snail, you meet this cat who's recently inherited a restaurant from his father who was a legendary cook, and get an opportunity to work there. Not only you have to cook the "pies" by yourself, but you also get to manage different aspects of the workplace, such as the maximum amount of tables, working hour and even advertising

You start off with a limited supply of ingredients, tray sizes, menu options and decorations, but the more the time passes by, the more complex things get. In between days, you get to meet different characters and learn a little more about their background and stories, but I won't get into details in order to prevent spoilers about it. Speaking about it, there's a limited amount of days available to work with, and depending on your choices there might be some unique paths throughout the simulation

The graphics, sound effects and music are simple, but actually quite decent. As for the gameplay, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone who doesn't like to deal with stress, as you need to deliver the orders as fast as you can to receive the best possible grade and although you're free to develop your own menu with the desired names and ingredients combinations, it's advisable to remember about them, as checking it often consumes time. If that's not troublesome enough, you don't get an infinite amount of resources to work with, so you need to watch out to ask for a re-supply at the right time, otherwise you'd might fail to deliver orders

Another thing that I'd also like to mention is that the developer is also one of those sadistic types, as you need to grind as much as you can in order to unlock all the possible achievements, so think twice before jumping in this boat if you're obsessed with perfect scores

Overall, it's a decent mix of simulation tycoon experience for anyone who loves a good pizza and, what the heck, a lil' dose of stress as well

とにかくカスタマイズ性が高くてとても面白かった。
まず材料の品質から厨房に置く数、配送業者まで決められます。
それを使ってどんなメニューを置くか、名前、値段なども設定。
そして広告の手段や営業時間など、大抵のことはできます。
どこに金をかければ売れるのか、かなり考えさせられました。
見た目の設定だけはできないけれど、置いている設備によって背景に変化があるあたり本当に芸が細かい。

一転して販売パートはとにかく手を動かす感じ。
肝は材料の補充をいつするか。余り過ぎるとロスになるし、足りないと注文されたメニューを出せない。
配送時間もかかるのも考慮して最もコスパのいいタイミングを見極めるのがかなり難しいです。
プレイヤースキルはそこそこ要求されますが、難易度選択できるので安心。

紹介動画の通り、UI類がシンプルながらかわいい。細かいグラフィックもちゃんと作ってあって嬉しい。画面が退屈になることがありません。

ストーリーもテンポよく軽妙な会話が行われている雰囲気。ちまちま翻訳しながら頑張ったけど途中で断念。
文章量がけっこうあり（日本語並感）、選択肢もけっこうな頻度。
また、何らかの条件で分岐しているようです。とりあえず１周したけどブタに会えませんでした。
そして、会話パートによってお店に影響があることも。
日本語実装が絶望的なのが悲しいところ。

セールで買ったけど、定価を出せるボリュームがありました。
シンプルな販売パートを引き立てるため、それ以外の部分にカスタマイズ要素がこれでもかと詰め込まれています。
ファミコン調という魅力を活かし、細かいところまで行き届いた、とても洗練されたゲームだと思います。
PV通りなのでピンと来たら即購入してほしい。期待を裏切らない。

I paid 70 cents for this, and went into Pizza Express expecting a shallow but fun cooking time management game. Well, it's definitely a cooking time management game- I don't know if there's a better genre name for that, but sort of in the vein of Cook Serve Delicious and similar games- but I was pleasantly surprised by Pizza Express's depth.

The core gameplay is pretty typical "make customer's pizza orders as quickly, accurately and efficiently as you can", but there's an entire in-depth system for building pizzas with balanced flavors and you have to build your own menu. There's also a branching storyline- even the kinds of pizzas you choose to serve can affect the story!

I'd gladly go back and buy this for full price.

A nice game about managing a pizza shop. The core gameplay consist of creating your own menu and then trying to serve pizzas to your clients on time. Of course, as the game progress you need to make a more and more complex menu to attract more and more people and being able to charge more which makes the game more and more difficult and hectic as days passes. Since you basically set the difficulty yourself with the way you configure your kitchen, this allows the game to be difficult without being frustrating.

The story and characters are also pretty fun which constantly made me want to continue playing just to see what will happen next. Even if the story has a lot of branching and i was lucky enough to get what i considered to be the most interesting one on my first playthrough. Also, it has some very cool chiptune music.

In the end i was very pleasantly satisfied by this game i randomly tried without having any expectation in the first place.
